name: @local/vibe64-project
description: Owns project selection, initial JSKIT project materialization, Env values, and session runtime creation.

surfaces.summary: Builds the shared setup requests delegated by onboarding controls and Colleague to Temporary AI.
Exports project actions, identifiers, and the shared project-change publisher.
Builds one Vibe64-owned JSKIT foundation commit and publishes it through an explicit repository authority, or creates an empty canonical repository for a caller to fill.
Validates semantic host resource values and maps them through exact application-declared environment bindings.
Validates a host's saved Env value provider (vibe64.saved-env-values.v1) and turns the values the person linked into non-editable Development Env records.
Owns original managed project creation and exact training source proof; defaults a host adds remain its own facility.
Archives a project into a validated bundle, or removes a practice project, through one resumable deletion lifecycle; hosts add their own resources.
